mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (id, user_id, title, content, category) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.category, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.user_id, u.nickname as authorNickname FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.user_id, u.nickname as authorNickname FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
